title: CedulaDigitalCredential
description: The Cedula Digital - national identity credential of the Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia (demo) (demo), with eIDAS-2-PID-inspired claims. For demonstration only.

familyName.description: Current family name(s) of the citizen

givenName.description: Current first name(s) of the citizen

birthDate.description: Date of birth as a dateint (YYYYMMDD), so AnonCreds predicate proofs (age over 18) work without revealing the date

personalIdentifier.description: Unique personal identifier assigned by the SEGIP (demo)

portrait.description: Portrait photo of the citizen as a data URI
